description: The claim AIREC-004 exists to prevent. Allergen absence cannot be established from an ingredient's name — it depends on the brand, the facility and the rest of the recipe — so AiAllergenEffectKind has no 'Removes' member and an answer asserting one does not deserialize. Rejected rather than dropped: a validator that discarded the value would show the creator an answer the model did not give.
